cases.brief: A short proof must retain the positivity qualification and its sign explanation.
cases.draft: Let c > 0. If a <= b, then b-a >= 0. Multiplying by the positive number 1/c gives (b-a)/c >= 0, so a/c <= b/c. The assumption c > 0 is essential: division by a negative number reverses the inequality.
